description: Generate an image or video from a prompt with any model in the PixelDojo catalog. With no `model`, a prompt runs on seedream-5, which makes still images only. For a video, name seedance-2-5, which works from a prompt alone or a starting image. If a provider refuses the content, retry once on wan-3-0-video (video) or seedream-5 (images), the least-restricted models. For a multi-shot film or a music video synced to a song use pixeldojo_film; to change, move or extend an existing clip use pixeldojo_video. These are the models the PixelDojo studios use; name another only when the user asks for it. References: `image_url`/`image_urls` for stills, `video_url` for a source clip, `image_path`/`image_paths` for absolute local files (uploaded to 24h temp storage first). A clip or an audio track URL with no `model` runs on seedance-2-reference; a named model that cannot read a clip is swapped for it and the result says so, while a named model with no audio input drops the track. Model-specific settings go in `params` alongside an explicit `model`. Returns asset URLs, or a jobId for pixeldojo_status when the job outlasts the 30s wait.

aspect_ratio.description: e.g. "1:1", "16:9", "9:16". Snapped to the nearest ratio the model supports, and dropped if the model has no aspect_ratio field.

duration.description: Video length in seconds. Snapped or clamped to what the model allows, and dropped if the model has no duration field. Required for grok-video-extend (the extension length).

image_path.description: Absolute local file path to a reference image or clip (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, MP4, WebM, MOV; no audio). The skill uploads it to 24h temp storage and uses the URL as image_url. Ignored when image_url is also set.

image_paths.description: Multiple absolute local file paths (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, MP4, WebM, MOV), each uploaded to 24h temp storage and used as a reference, same rules as image_urls.

image_url.description: Reference still for image-to-image / image-to-video. A clip URL (.mp4/.mov/.webm) or an audio track URL (.mp3/.wav/.m4a/...) here is detected by extension and routed as that kind of media instead.

image_urls.description: Multiple reference image URLs for models that accept a reference set (character + wardrobe + location, for example). Single-reference models use the first and ignore the rest.

model.description: Model apiId. Recommended (the models the PixelDojo studios use): "seedream-5" for images (the default), "seedance-2-5" for video (prompt only or a starting image), "wan-3-0-video" for video the others refuse. Use another model only when the user names one. Full catalog: https://pixeldojo.ai/api/v1/models; one model's fields: https://pixeldojo.ai/llm/{apiId}.txt. Omit for seedream-5, which makes still images only; name a video model to get a video.

params.description: Advanced settings for the model that runs this, named exactly as that model documents them (e.g. {"resolution": "1080p", "seed": 42}). Set `model` in the same call: field names differ per model, so params without one are refused. Applied last, so these override anything derived from the other inputs. An invalid field comes back named with its allowed values and nothing is charged, so fix it and call again.

preset.description: Preset slug that seeds the running model's settings; explicit fields and params override it. Each preset belongs to one model (browse them by model at https://pixeldojo.ai/presets), so set `model` to that preset's model: a slug the running model has no preset for is rejected with a 400 before any charge.

prompt.description: Prompt describing what to generate. Write @Name to use a character or element the user saved in Character Studio ("@Mara on a beach"): its photos are attached automatically on models that take reference images. pixeldojo_library source=characters lists them.

resolution.description: Output resolution when the model supports it (e.g. "480p", "720p", "1080p", "4k"). Snapped to the nearest tier the model offers, and dropped if the model has no resolution field. Lower tiers cost fewer credits.

video_url.description: Source video clip to animate / restyle / extend. Use this for videos; image_url is for still frames. With no model, a clip runs on seedance-2-reference; a named model with no clip input is swapped for it and the result says so.

name: pixeldojo_generate
title: Generate image or video
